answer: Randomized admission lottery. Each epoch, agents request slots; a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon assigns slots so the attacker cannot precompute outcomes or target a chosen epoch. To hold a slot past a velvet deadline, an identity must echo a fresh beacon-derived challenge within seconds. Missing it forfeits the slot, pushing the attacker to the next ledge of uncertain timing. Cost: continuous beacon monitoring plus a forfeited slot per failed challenge, paid per identity.
